title: Sample light-space transmittance in particle_mesh.frag for self-shadow
purpose: Modulate particle lighting by light-space transmittance to achieve self-shadowing with minimal cost.

steps.detail: Add a combined image sampler binding for the DSM/transmittance image in the mesh descriptor set (new binding).
In particle_mesh.frag, transform fragWorldPos by lightView and lightProj to get NDC; map to [0,1] UV and sample the DSM; clamp UV in-bounds.
Multiply the lighting term by sampled transmittance; add a runtime toggle to enable/disable DSM-based self-shadowing quickly.
Ensure a Sync2 barrier transitions the DSM image to SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL before sampling in the mesh pass.

acceptance: Self-shadowing visible and controllable via toggle; darker where integrated particle depth is high
No descriptor layout mismatches; correct image layout during sampling
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('Descriptor image layout matching at draw')
search_vulkan_spec('Coordinate transforms for NDC to UV')
notes: Keep DSM resolution modest (e.g., 1024) for speed; consider bilateral blur later for smoother look.
